name: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
bio: These are the unattributed poems of the Man'yōshū (万葉集, "Collection of Ten Thousand Leaves"), the oldest anthology of Japanese poetry, compiled in its present form around 759 and drawing on poems of the 7th and 8th centuries. Many of its poems are signed by named courtiers, but a large share of the twenty books carries no composer: love songs, travel poems, laments and verses of the seasons whose makers are unknown or unrecorded.

The group also includes poems from two famous sections of the anthology. The Azuma-uta (東歌, Eastland songs) of Book 14 are folk-flavoured verses from the eastern provinces, many in the local speech of the region; the sakimori-uta (防人歌, frontier-guard songs) are the poems of conscripts from the east sent to defend northern Kyushu, and of their families. Only poems whose headnote and left-note name no composer are gathered here; the selection follows the poem numbers (Kokka taikan numbering) discussed in Saitō Mokichi's Man'yō shūka (1938), and the text is that of the 1891 Kogi reading text of Kamochi Masazumi, as transcribed on Japanese Wikisource, with its reading-aids removed.

poems.title: MYS 1074: 春日山おして照らせる (Kasugayama oshite teraseru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 月を詠める
poems.text: 春日山おして照らせるこの月は妹が庭にも清けかるらし

poems.title: MYS 1075: 海原の道遠みかも (Unahara no michi tōmi kamo)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 月を詠める
poems.text: 海原の道遠みかも月読の光少き夜は更ちつつ

poems.title: MYS 1089: 大海に島もあらなくに (Ōumi ni shima mo aranaku ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 7; the left-note says it was made while accompanying a royal progress to Ise (従駕). 題詞: 雲を詠める
poems.text: 大海に島もあらなくに海原のたゆたふ波に立てる白雲

poems.title: MYS 1095: 三諸つく三輪山見れば (Mimorotsuku Miwayama mireba)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 山を詠める
poems.text: 三諸つく三輪山見れば隠国の泊瀬の桧原思ほゆるかも

poems.title: MYS 1122: 山の際に渡る秋沙の (Yama no ma ni wataru akisa no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 鳥を詠める
poems.text: 山の際に渡る秋沙の行きて居むその川の瀬に波立つなゆめ

poems.title: MYS 1138: 宇治川を船渡せをと (Ujigawa o funawatase o to)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 山背にてよめる
poems.text: 宇治川を船渡せをと呼ばへども聞こえざるらし楫の音もせず

poems.title: MYS 1140: しなが鳥猪名野を来れば (Shinagadori Inano o kureba)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 摂津にてよめる
poems.text: しなが鳥猪名野を来れば有馬山夕霧立ちぬ宿は無くして

poems.title: MYS 1179: 家にして吾は恋ひむな (Ie ni shite are wa koimu na)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 覊旅にてよめる
poems.text: 家にして吾は恋ひむな印南野の浅茅が上に照りし月夜を

poems.title: MYS 1240: 玉くしげ見諸戸山を (Tamakushige Mimorotoyama o)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 覊旅にてよめる
poems.text: 玉くしげ見諸戸山を行きしかば面白くして古思ほゆ

poems.title: MYS 1263: 暁と夜烏鳴けど (Akatsuki to yogarasu nakedo)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 7; the left-note places it in a group from an 'old poetry collection' (古歌集). 題詞: 時に臨けてよめる
poems.text: 暁と夜烏鳴けどこの岡の木末の上はいまだ静けし

poems.title: MYS 1336: 冬こもり春の大野を (Fuyugomori haru no Ōno o)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 草に寄す
poems.text: 冬こもり春の大野を焼く人は焼き足らねかも吾が心焼く

poems.title: MYS 1406: 秋津野に朝居る雲の (Akizuno ni asa'iru kumo no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 挽歌
poems.text: 秋津野に朝居る雲の失せぬれば昨日も今日も亡き人思ほゆ

poems.title: MYS 1411: 幸はひのいかなる人か (Sakiwai no ikanaru hito ka)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 挽歌
poems.text: 幸はひのいかなる人か黒髪の白くなるまで妹が声を聞く

poems.title: MYS 1412: 我が背子をいづく行かめと (Wa ga se ko o izuku yukame to)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 7. 題詞: 挽歌
poems.text: 我が背子をいづく行かめとさき竹の背向に寝しく今し悔しも

poems.title: MYS 1714: 落ちたぎち流るる水の (Ochitagichi nagaruru mizu no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 9; the left-note records the three poems of the group as by an unknown author (作者未詳). 題詞: 芳野の離宮に幸せる時の歌二首
poems.text: 落ちたぎち流るる水の岩に触り淀める淀に月の影見ゆ

poems.title: MYS 1791: 旅人の宿りせむ野に (Tabibito no yadori semu no ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Hanka (envoy) of a mother's poem to her only son, sent with the embassy to Tang China, Book 9. 題詞: 天平五年癸酉、遣唐使の船、難波よりいづる時、親母が子に贈れる歌一首、また短歌
poems.text: 旅人の宿りせむ野に霜降らば吾が子羽ぐくめ天の鶴群

poems.title: MYS 1821: 春霞流るるなべに (Harugasumi nagaruru nabe ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 鳥を詠める
poems.text: 春霞流るるなべに青柳の枝くひ持ちて鴬鳴くも

poems.title: MYS 1875: 春されば木隠れ多き (Haru sareba kogakure ōki)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 月を詠める
poems.text: 春されば木隠れ多き夕月夜おほつかなしも山陰にして

poems.title: MYS 1879: 春日野に煙立つ見ゆ (Kasugano ni keburi tatsu miyu)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 煙を詠める
poems.text: 春日野に煙立つ見ゆ娘子らし春野のうはぎ摘みて煮らしも

poems.title: MYS 1883: 百敷の大宮人は (Momoshiki no ōmiyabito wa)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 野の遊び
poems.text: 百敷の大宮人は暇あれや梅を挿頭してここに集へる

poems.title: MYS 1917: 春雨に衣はいたく (Harusame ni koromo wa itaku)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 雨に寄す
poems.text: 春雨に衣はいたく通らめや七日し降らば七夜来じとや

poems.title: MYS 1976: 卯の花の咲き散る岡よ (U no hana no sakichiru oka yo)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 問答
poems.text: 卯の花の咲き散る岡よ霍公鳥鳴きてさ渡る君は聞きつや

poems.title: MYS 2096: 真葛原靡く秋風 (Makuzuhara nabiku akikaze)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 花を詠める
poems.text: 真葛原靡く秋風吹くごとに阿太の大野の萩が花散る

poems.title: MYS 2128: 秋風に大和へ越ゆる (Akikaze ni Yamato e koyuru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 雁を詠める
poems.text: 秋風に大和へ越ゆる雁がねはいや遠ざかる雲隠りつつ

poems.title: MYS 2137: 朝にゆく雁の鳴く音は (Tsuto ni yuku kari no naku ne wa)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 雁を詠める
poems.text: 朝にゆく雁の鳴く音は我がごとく物思へかも声の悲しき

poems.title: MYS 2147: 山の辺にい行く猟夫は (Yama no be ni iyuku satsuo wa)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 鹿鳴を詠める
poems.text: 山の辺にい行く猟夫は多かれど山にも野にもさ牡鹿鳴くも

poems.title: MYS 2158: 秋風の寒く吹くなべ (Akikaze no samuku fuku nabe)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 蟋を詠める
poems.text: 秋風の寒く吹くなべ我が屋戸の浅茅が本に蟋蟀鳴くも

poems.title: MYS 2170: 秋萩の枝もとををに (Akihagi no eda mo to-o-o ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 露を詠める
poems.text: 秋萩の枝もとををに露霜置き寒くも時はなりにけるかも

poems.title: MYS 2180: 九月のしぐれの雨に (Nagatsuki no shigure no ame ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 黄葉を詠める
poems.text: 九月のしぐれの雨に濡れとほり春日の山は色づきにけり

poems.title: MYS 2185: 大坂を吾が越え来れば (Ōsaka o a ga koekureba)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 黄葉を詠める
poems.text: 大坂を吾が越え来れば二上にもみち葉流る時雨降りつつ

poems.title: MYS 2190: 我が門の浅茅色づく (Wa ga kado no asaji irozuku)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 黄葉を詠める
poems.text: 我が門の浅茅色づく吉隠の浪柴の野の黄葉散るらし

poems.title: MYS 2220: さ牡鹿の妻呼ぶ山の (Saoshika no tsuma yobu yama no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 水田を詠める
poems.text: さ牡鹿の妻呼ぶ山の岡辺なる早稲田は刈らじ霜は降るとも

poems.title: MYS 2227: 思はぬにしぐれの雨は (Omowanu ni shigure no ame wa)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 月を詠める
poems.text: 思はぬにしぐれの雨は降りたれど天雲晴れて月夜さやけし

poems.title: MYS 2277: さ牡鹿の入野のすすき (Saoshika no Irino no susuki)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 花に寄す
poems.text: さ牡鹿の入野のすすき初尾花いつしか妹が衣手枕かむ

poems.title: MYS 2323: 我が背子を今か今かと (Wa ga se ko o ima ka ima ka to)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 雪を詠める
poems.text: 我が背子を今か今かと出で見れば沫雪降れり庭もほどろに

poems.title: MYS 2336: はなはだも夜更けてな行き (Hanahada mo yofukete na yuki)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous poem, Book 10. 題詞: 霜に寄す
poems.text: はなはだも夜更けてな行き道の辺のゆ笹がうへに霜の降る夜を

poems.title: MYS 2517: たらちねの母に障らば (Tarachine no haha ni sawaraba)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: たらちねの母に障らばいたづらに汝も吾も事成るべしや

poems.title: MYS 2520: 苅薦の一重を敷きて (Karikomo no hitoe o shikite)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 苅薦の一重を敷きてさ寝れども君とし寝れば寒けくもなし

poems.title: MYS 2540: 振分けの髪を短み (Furiwake no kami o mijikami)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 振分けの髪を短み春草を髪にたくらむ妹をしぞ思ふ

poems.title: MYS 2546: 思はぬに至らば妹が (Omowanu ni itaraba imo ga)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 思はぬに至らば妹が嬉しみと笑まむ眉引思ほゆるかも

poems.title: MYS 2547: かくばかり恋ひむものそと (Kakubakari koimu mono so to)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: かくばかり恋ひむものそと思はねば妹が手本をまかぬ夜もありき

poems.title: MYS 2554: 相見ては面隠さるる (Aimite wa omo kakusaruru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 相見ては面隠さるるものからに継ぎて見まくの欲しき君かも

poems.title: MYS 2560: 人もなき古りにし里に (Hito mo naki furinishi sato ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 人もなき古りにし里にある人をめぐくや君が恋に死なせむ

poems.title: MYS 2572: 偽りも似つきてそする (Itsuwari mo nitsukite so suru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.

poems.title: MYS 2579: 早ゆきていつしか君を (Haya yukite itsushika kimi o)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.title: MYS 2580: 面形の忘れてあらば (Omokata no wasurete araba)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.
poems.text: 面形の忘れてあらばあぢきなく男じものや恋ひつつ居らむ

poems.title: MYS 2582: あぢきなく何の狂言 (Ajikinaku nani no tawakoto)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.note: Anonymous love poem (相聞), Book 11.

poems.title: MYS 2616: 奥山の真木の板戸を (Okuyama no maki no itato o)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)

poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Azuma-uta (Eastland song), Book 14.
poems.text: 昨夜こそは子ろとさ寝しか雲の上ゆ鳴きゆく鶴の間遠く思ほゆ

poems.title: MYS 3569: 防人に立ちし朝明の (Sakimori ni tachishi asake no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Sakimori-uta (frontier guard's song), Book 14. 題詞: 防人の歌
poems.text: 防人に立ちし朝明の金門出に手放れ惜しみ泣きし子らはも

poems.title: MYS 3570: 葦の葉に夕霧立ちて (Ashi no ha ni yūgiri tachite)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Sakimori-uta (frontier guard's song), Book 14. 題詞: 防人の歌
poems.text: 葦の葉に夕霧立ちて鴨が音の寒き夕へし汝をば偲はむ

poems.title: MYS 3602: 青丹よし奈良の都に (Aoniyoshi Nara no miyako ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 15; the left-note classifies it as a poem of clouds. 題詞: 所につきて誦詠へる古き歌
poems.text: 青丹よし奈良の都にたなびける天の白雲見れど飽かぬかも

poems.title: MYS 3605: わたつみの海に出でたる (Watatsumi no umi ni idetaru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 15; the left-note classifies it as a love poem. 題詞: 所につきて誦詠へる古き歌
poems.text: わたつみの海に出でたる飾磨川絶えむ日にこそ吾が恋やまめ

poems.title: MYS 3806: 事しあらば小泊瀬山の (Koto shi araba Obatsuseyama no)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 16; a young woman's poem sent to her lover. 題詞: 娘子が夫に贈れる歌一首
poems.text: 事しあらば小泊瀬山の石城にも隠らば共にな思ひ我が背

poems.title: MYS 3807: 安積山影さへ見ゆる (Asakayama kage sae miyuru)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 16; the left-note says a former court serving-woman (前の采女) recited it to appease Prince Katsuragi in Michinoku. 題詞: 前の采女が詠める歌一首
poems.text: 安積山影さへ見ゆる山の井の浅き心を吾が思はなくに

poems.title: MYS 3846: 法師らが鬚の剃り杭 (Hōshira ga hige no sori kui)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Comic poem mocking a Buddhist priest, Book 16. 題詞: 戯れに僧を嗤ける歌一首
poems.text: 法師らが鬚の剃り杭馬繋ぎいたくな引きそ法師半ら欠む

poems.title: MYS 3873: 吾が門に千鳥しば鳴く (Wa ga kado ni chidori shiba naku)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 16, among the 'nameless songs' (無名歌六首). 題詞: 無名歌六首
poems.text: 吾が門に千鳥しば鳴く起きよ起きよ我が一夜夫人に知らゆな

poems.title: MYS 4425: 防人にゆくは誰が夫と (Sakimori ni yuku wa ta ga se to)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Sakimori-uta (frontier guard's song), Book 20, from the group of eight 'old' sakimori poems (昔年の防人の歌) that the left-note says were copied for Ōtomo no Yakamochi; no composer is named. Spoken by a guard's wife (防人の妻, in Saitō Mokichi's labelling).
poems.text: 防人にゆくは誰が夫と問ふ人を見るが羨しさ物思ひもせず

poems.title: MYS 4431: 笹が葉のさやく霜夜に (Sasa ga ha no sayaku shimoyo ni)
poems.author: Anonymous (Man'yōshū)
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Sakimori-uta (frontier guard's song), Book 20, from the group of eight 'old' sakimori poems (昔年の防人の歌) that the left-note says were copied for Ōtomo no Yakamochi; no composer is named.
poems.text: 笹が葉のさやく霜夜に七重着る衣に増せる子ろが肌はも
